note: Set B is better because it avoids several specific tag binding errors present in Set A. Set A incorrectly binds 'Vanity & Sink' to tag MWB01 (which is Horizontal Cabinet) and 'Horizontal Cabinet' quantity to tag MWK03 (which is Base Cabinet Sink). Set B extracts these facts correctly without attaching the wrong tags, though it shares errors with Set A regarding Millwork tags MWK02/MWK03 and invents a 'Kitchen' location for Quartz not found in the text.
remarks: Both sets truncate values ('PORCELA', 'TIERRA S') and invent a 'Kitchen' location for Quartz. Both struggle with Millwork tags MWK02 and MWK03, but Set A has additional tag binding errors for MWB01 and MWK05 in the visible claims.
